prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Browse live personalities and pick the pet that fits your desktop vibe."]
2: ["How to Interact With Your Pet", "Learn the simple desktop gestures: click to summon, right-click to hide, or drag to reposition.", "Right-click pet for Quick Menu\nDrag anywhere on screen\nDouble-click to chat"]
3: ["Find Your Ideal Desktop Match", "Select your work style to discover your recommended pet companion path.", "Chill Companion (Low Attention) vs Energetic Buddy (Interactive)"]
4: ["Did you know? You can feed your desktop pet shortcut treats while working!"]
5: ["Log in with your existing account to recover existing pets and preserve progress.", "Sign in to keep your pet saved across all your desktop devices."]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use well-lit, front-facing photos with clear background contrast for best results."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your pet a name", "Official Desktop Companion"]
8: ["Feel free to minimize! We'll notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready.", "Ready Notification Enabled"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop!", "Let's make sure your pet appears correctly on screen.", "Test Pet Display", "Pet visible on screen\nPermissions granted\nStartup on boot enabled"]
